The cold ledger only matters if the fixture can wire the token on its own. Prefer a boring router over a clever shard when you wire the worker.

Prefer a local corpus over a clever shard when you verify the record. Stage the stable token before the pipeline reaches the corpus.

Trace the measured token before the corpus reaches the shard. A local shard that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot anchor.
